title: AMI 2.0: A Generational Opportunity to Transform Utilities
content: Advanced metering infrastructure (AMI) 2.0 presents an opportunity to transform how utilities operate across technology, strategy, and culture. AMI 2.0 provides a rare chance to modernize operations, build greater customer trust, and prepare the workforce for future challenges. However, to unlock its full potential, utilities need to change their mindset: AMI 2.0 is not simply a “technology project”; it is the foundation of enterprise-wide modernization.
